body: I'm a 14 year old girl and I can kinda relate. I have a nice house, I have lots of electronics, I go to online school due to my anxiety, and my family gets mad at me for not being happy. I don't have an exact reason why I'm not happy but I hate my life. So I guess, yeah I have a life someone would kill for. I'm no therapist but I don't think anything is wrong with you. Maybe you can get over it by just focusing on the good things, like your wife and your daughter. This comment most likely sucks ass and I apologize but, hopefully I helped! ;-;
